title: Eleven Hundred Turns
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（科学与技术·风能与创新）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（科学与技术·风能与创新）　|　核心词汇：wind　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wind 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was ① wind on that hill on every day of the year, which is why the mill stood there in 1791 and why the turbine stands there now, and it is the only thing about the place that has never changed. The track up ② winds for eleven hundred metres between two hedges, and my grandfather said a road that goes straight up a hill is a road nobody uses.

In 1961 he did the ③ winding of the coil himself, eleven hundred turns, and he said the number was the whole of it and that a machine is only arithmetic you can touch. Every Sunday he had to ④ wind the clock, at six, and my grandmother said the clock was the only thing in that house he was ever on time for.

In 1974 the council ⑤ got wind of what he had built in the shed and sent a man out, and the man looked at it for eleven minutes and said it was not dangerous, which was not the question, and no wind, my grandfather said, is ever wasted.

After 1976 he never got his ⑥ wind back: eleven steps and he had to stop, and he said a man who cannot walk up a hill has no business living on one. He had played in the village ⑦ wind band for thirty-one years, on a cornet, and he said the wind is the only part of a band that has to breathe.

In 1989 the ⑧ winding up of the scheme took eleven months and eleven forms, and he said he had built a machine in a shed in 1961 with less paper than that. The ⑨ wind, meaning the thing on the hill, is still there, and the turbine turns, and eleven houses are lit by it, which he would have liked. The ⑩ wind I remember from the day he died was from the east, which he said was the worst of them, and I have no idea whether that is true.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 呼吸；气息（get one's wind back）
C. n. 管乐；吹奏乐（wind band）
D. v. 蜿蜒；曲折而行（/waɪnd/）
E. v. 缠绕；绕上（线圈等）
F. v. 上发条（wind a clock）
G. 固定搭配：get wind of ... 听到……的风声；得知
H. 固定搭配：wind up（结束、清算）／winding up 收尾、结业

items.q: There was wind on that hill
The track up winds for eleven hundred
he did the winding of the coil
he had to wind the clock
the council got wind of what
he never got his wind back
He had played in the village wind band
the winding up of the scheme
The wind, meaning the thing on the hill
The wind I remember from the day

answers.why: wind 意为“风”，那座山上一年到头每一天都有风，所以 1791 年磨坊建在那里，如今涡轮机也立在那里。
winds 是动词 /waɪnd/，意为“蜿蜒、曲折而行”，上山的路在两道树篱之间蜿蜒一千一百米。
winding 意为“缠绕、绕线”，1961 年他自己绕线圈，绕了一千一百匝。
wind the clock 意为“给钟上发条”，每个星期天六点他都得给钟上发条。
get wind of ... 意为“听到……的风声、得知”，1974 年议会得知了他在棚屋里造的东西，就派了个人来。
wind 意为“呼吸、气息”，1976 年之后他的气再也回不来了：走十一级台阶就得停下。
wind band 意为“管乐队、吹奏乐队”，他在村里的管乐队吹了三十一年短号。
winding up 意为“结束、清算、收尾”，1989 年这个项目的收尾用了十一个月和十一张表格。
the wind 意为“风”，山上的风还在，涡轮机还在转，十一户人家靠它照明。
the wind 意为“风”，他去世那天我记得刮的是东风，他说东风是最糟的一种。
